finding_key: docs/design/docs/docs-tables.md::cell-style clear semantics changed but the canonical tables design doc was not updated (still shows `backgroundcolor=""` as a stored cell attribute)
evidence: docs/design/docs/docs-tables.md (tree diagram, ~line 138) still shows `cell(backgroundColor="" verticalAlign="top" …)` and the cell-attribute list describes backgroundColor only as "CSS color string", while the PR adds removedCellStyleAttrs/removeStyleByPath in packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts (~249, ~2443) establishing that cleared cell attributes are removed from the node — and the empty-string value the doc depicts is exactly the invalid pattern issue #728 eliminates. The diff updates two other design docs but not this one, so the staleness claim is accurate. Impact is documentation-only, hence minor.
